# `m.stocks.financials.balance_sheets`

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Balance sheets of US public companies, one row per filer and reporting period.

```python
m.stocks.financials.balance_sheets(symbols=None, *, timeframe=None, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

## Arguments

What each argument does for this dataset, and the rule it follows for every dataset that takes it.

| Argument | For this dataset | For every dataset |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `symbols` | Tickers whose filings to return; leave it out for every filing. | Massive's ticker for each symbol, spelled exactly as Massive spells it: `AAPL` or `BRK.B` for a stock, `O:SPY271217C00700000` (the OCC code) for an option, `I:SPX` for an index, `C:EURUSD` for a forex pair, `X:BTCUSD` for a crypto pair, and `ESZ6` for a future. Pass one symbol as text, several as a list, or a table with a `Symbol` column. A live table is followed: each symbol you add is read, and each one you delete stops being read. `last_by()`, `fetch()`, `history()`, and most polls also drop a deleted symbol's rows. `dm.ALL` reads every symbol, and leaving the argument out reads every record with no filter by symbol, where this dataset takes them. A misspelled symbol in text or a list raises `ValueError` at the call; by default, a misspelled row of a table is skipped and logged, and the table keeps running. `dm.canonical_symbol` converts other spellings to Massive's. A record that lists several symbols, such as a news article, appears once for each symbol you named that it lists. |
| `timeframe` | `dm.Timeframe.ANNUAL` or `QUARTERLY`; leave it out for both. A balance sheet has no trailing twelve months. |  |
| `start` | The first period end date. | The first day or moment of the range. A date (text such as `"2025-06-02"`, a Python `date`, or a Deephaven `LocalDate`) means the day in the market's time zone: New York for stocks, options, and indices; UTC for forex and crypto; for futures, the trading session that ends that day. An instant is an exact time: a Python `datetime` with a time zone, a `pandas.Timestamp`, a `numpy.datetime64`, a Deephaven `Instant` or `ZonedDateTime`, or Deephaven time text such as `"2025-06-02T09:30 ET"`. Give `start` and `end` as two dates or two instants. A `datetime` without a time zone raises `ValueError`, and a calendar-date field, such as an ex-dividend date, takes dates only. |
| `end` | The last period end date. | The last day, or the moment the range stops, in the same form as `start`. A date includes its whole day, so `start="2025-06-02", end="2025-06-02"` reads all of June 2; an instant is excluded. Leave it out to read through now; a list dataset then sends Massive no end, so it also returns records still to come, such as dividends announced but not yet paid. |
| `sort` | Any field of the rows, such as `"fiscal_year"`. | The field to order the rows by, named as Massive names it, such as `"ex_dividend_date"`. Where the endpoint allows, name several, separated by commas, each with an optional `.asc` or `.desc`: `"ticker,ex_dividend_date.desc"`. This page lists the values the dataset takes. |
| `order` | The direction of `sort`. | The direction of `sort`: `dm.Order.ASC` or `dm.Order.DESC`. |
| `limit` | The most rows to return, in total. A watchlist's `fetch()` caps every request instead. | The most rows Massive returns for the whole request, across every symbol you name, kept in Massive's order: ask for newest first (`order=dm.Order.DESC`) to keep the latest. A symbol that comes first can use up the whole limit, so leave `limit` out when you need every row of each symbol. A `fetch()` that follows a table of symbols applies it to each symbol's request, and this dataset's own line says where else it applies to each symbol. |
| `filters` | Further endpoint parameters, such as `{"fiscal_year_gte": 2020}`. | Any other parameter Massive documents for this dataset, as a mapping from the parameter's name to its value, with each dot in the name written as `_`: Massive's `strike_price.gte` is `strike_price_gte`. This page lists the keys the dataset takes. A key it doesn't take, or one that has its own argument, such as `start`, raises `ValueError` naming the keys it does take. A date or time value takes ISO 8601 text, or any value `start` takes. |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The ticker the request named that the row lists in `Tickers`: a row that lists several of the named tickers appears once for each, so an article about AAPL and MSFT read for both is listed under each. A request that named one ticker gives it to every row. Null when the call named no ticker, and on a row that lists none of a request's named tickers. | REST |
| `AccountsPayable` | double | Amounts owed to suppliers and vendors for goods and services purchased on credit. | REST |
| `AccruedAndOtherCurrentLiabilities` | double | Current liabilities not classified elsewhere, including accrued expenses, taxes payable, and other obligations due within one year. | REST |
| `AccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncome` | double | Cumulative gains and losses that bypass the income statement, including foreign currency translation adjustments and unrealized gains/losses on securities. | REST |
| `AdditionalPaidInCapital` | double | Amount received from shareholders in excess of the par or stated value of shares issued. | REST |
| `CashAndEquivalents` | double | Cash on hand and short-term, highly liquid investments that are readily convertible to known amounts of cash. | REST |
| `Cik` | String | The company's Central Index Key (CIK), a unique identifier assigned by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). You can look up a company's CIK using the SEC CIK Lookup tool (https://www.sec.gov/search-filings/cik-lookup). | REST |
| `CommitmentsAndContingencies` | double | Disclosed amount related to contractual commitments and potential liabilities that may arise from uncertain future events. | REST |
| `CommonStock` | double | Par or stated value of common shares outstanding representing basic ownership in the company. | REST |
| `DebtCurrent` | double | Short-term borrowings and the current portion of long-term debt due within one year. | REST |
| `DeferredRevenueCurrent` | double | Customer payments received in advance for goods or services to be delivered within one year. | REST |
| `FilingDate` | String | The date of the most recent SEC filing that included this period's data. This is not necessarily the date this period was originally filed. Because SEC filings restate comparative data for prior periods, multiple records can share the same filing_date. For example, an annual 10-K reports three years of results, and a 10-Q includes prior period comparatives. To find the original filing date for a specific 10-K or 10-Q, use the SEC EDGAR filings index endpoint (/stocks/filings/vX/index). | REST |
| `FiscalQuarter` | long | The fiscal quarter number (1, 2, 3, or 4) for the reporting period. | REST |
| `FiscalYear` | long | The fiscal year for the reporting period. | REST |
| `Goodwill` | double | Intangible asset representing the excess of purchase price over fair value of net assets acquired in business combinations. | REST |
| `IntangibleAssetsNet` | double | Intangible assets other than goodwill, including patents, trademarks, and customer relationships, net of accumulated amortization. | REST |
| `Inventories` | double | Raw materials, work-in-process, and finished goods held for sale in the ordinary course of business. | REST |
| `LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations` | double | Long-term borrowings and capital lease obligations with maturities greater than one year. | REST |
| `NoncontrollingInterest` | double | Equity in consolidated subsidiaries not owned by the parent company, representing minority shareholders' ownership. | REST |
| `OtherAssets` | double | Non-current assets not classified elsewhere, including long-term investments, deferred tax assets, and other long-term assets. | REST |
| `OtherCurrentAssets` | double | Current assets not classified elsewhere, including prepaid expenses, taxes receivable, and other assets expected to be converted to cash within one year. | REST |
| `OtherEquity` | double | Equity components not classified elsewhere in shareholders' equity. | REST |
| `OtherNoncurrentLiabilities` | double | Non-current liabilities not classified elsewhere, including deferred tax liabilities, pension obligations, and other long-term liabilities. | REST |
| `PeriodEnd` | String | The last date of the reporting period, representing the specific point in time when the balance sheet snapshot was taken. | REST |
| `PreferredStock` | double | Par or stated value of preferred shares outstanding with preferential rights over common stock. | REST |
| `PropertyPlantEquipmentNet` | double | Tangible fixed assets used in operations, reported net of accumulated depreciation. | REST |
| `Receivables` | double | Amounts owed to the company by customers and other parties, primarily accounts receivable, net of allowances for doubtful accounts. | REST |
| `RetainedEarningsDeficit` | double | Cumulative net income earned by the company less dividends paid to shareholders since inception. | REST |
| `ShortTermInvestments` | double | Marketable securities and other investments with maturities of one year or less that are not classified as cash equivalents. | REST |
| `Tickers` | String[] | A list of ticker symbols under which the company is listed. Multiple symbols may indicate different share classes for the same company. | REST |
| `Timeframe` | String | The reporting period type. Possible values include: quarterly, annual. | REST |
| `TotalAssets` | double | Sum of all current and non-current assets representing everything the company owns or controls. | REST |
| `TotalCurrentAssets` | double | Sum of all current assets expected to be converted to cash, sold, or consumed within one year. | REST |
| `TotalCurrentLiabilities` | double | Sum of all liabilities expected to be settled within one year. | REST |
| `TotalEquity` | double | Sum of all equity components representing shareholders' total ownership interest in the company. | REST |
| `TotalEquityAttributableToParent` | double | Total shareholders' equity attributable to the parent company, excluding noncontrolling interests. | REST |
| `TotalLiabilities` | double | Sum of all current and non-current liabilities representing everything the company owes. | REST |
| `TotalLiabilitiesAndEquity` | double | Sum of total liabilities and total equity, which should equal total assets per the fundamental accounting equation. | REST |
| `TreasuryStock` | double | Cost of the company's own shares that have been repurchased and are held in treasury, typically reported as a negative value. | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |
